support.quote: Chorus is built for interactive workloads where one model serves many independently scheduled agents. It runs local inference directly inside your process with continuous batching, priority scheduling, persistent conversation state, and a native C++ API and stable C ABI. No CUDA, Python runtime, cloud service, or separate inference server is required.
